offers.email_subject: Your first micro1 project offer is here!
offers.email_summary: micro1 Talent Operations officially invited Amber to join an AI training project as an Expert, applying professional experience to evaluate and train frontier AI models. Project-specific details are presented in the micro1 talent account.

selection_context.prior_path: Amber passed an internal screener and then a client screener. The earlier project ended before she received production work.
selection_context.return_invite_signal: Amber reports micro1/client explicitly stated that return invitations would be quality-based and that only the best/strongest performers would be invited back. Amber was invited back into Titan Beacon.
selection_context.rescreening: Amber reports that previously selected returnees were told they would not need to repeat the screeners; current onboarding appears consistent with prior client selection, but exact policy should be treated as user-reported until confirmed in project documentation.
selection_context.cohort_snapshot: Amber observed approximately 123 people in the current project environment, including managers. This is only a point-in-time visible-channel count and may grow; do not convert it into an exact acceptance percentile.
selection_context.earlier_funnel_scale: Amber recalls several thousand people, possibly roughly 6,000-10,000, in pre-onboarding. Exact funnel size is not verified and should not be presented as a precise statistic.
selection_context.interpretation: Strong evidence that Amber cleared a client/project quality threshold through screening performance. Do not claim a specific percentile or production-quality ranking because she had no production work on the earlier project.

offers.project_relationship_note: Amber believes Titan Beacon may be related to the earlier robot-training/video workflow involving robotic-arm or similar embodied-AI training. This relationship is not yet independently verified from available project materials, so do not merge it with another project solely on that assumption.
offers.source: User report from micro1 talent portal and project environment plus micro1 official offer email dated 2026-10-27. Amber confirmed on 2026-10-28 that she signed the contract and the project is live; on 2026-10-29 she confirmed office-hours, Slack-channel, and project-chatbot onboarding.

tracking_note: Treat Titan Beacon as a confirmed live $90/hour micro1 AI-training contract with active project onboarding. Keep distinct from other micro1 opportunities unless micro1 explicitly maps them together.
